correctness.rationale: Uses the prior published radical cycle binomial-edge ideal, and restricts to the faithfully flat rank-two frame cover to establish reducedness. Every independent T>=2 gives a rank-two component of dimension n-4, implying codimension n and regular-sequence hyperplane section; adjunction and standard Grassmann degree give the stated invariants. An exact differential-block decomposition proves the iff smoothness condition in any characteristic. On p35!=0 with zeros 1,2,4, direct elimination gives st=0 times n-5 free coordinates. The n=5 and n=6 low-dimensional components are classified directly by support and Segre parameterizations. Standalone enumerative finite-field verification checked all solutions for q=2,n=4..7 and q=3,n=4..6; these tests are independent corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: The exact smoothness condition classifies every singular point of a natural Calabi–Yau-type (trivial-dualizing) Grassmannian complete-intersection degeneration in all sizes and characteristics, not merely whether a graph has singular components. It detects the geometry of a stable genus-one nodal pentagon and a reducible K3-type surface with eight planes and three quadrics, and supplies an exact transverse node chart useful for studying higher-dimensional degenerations. These are natural whole-family intrinsic geometric questions rather than arbitrary numerical slices; prior component counts alone do not determine this pointwise geometry.
